Macrons

Consonantal i

Theme

Playground equipment, sandbox toys, vehicles and play

centre noun

a player

also center (player), centre forward

modern

Traupman 43, 46, 47, 48

centrālis, centrālis m./f.

declension

The adjective centrālis, central, is in Pliny; Traupman uses it as a noun for the centre in basketball, American football and hockey.

Examples

  • Quod ego statūrā prōcērā sum, ego centrālis sum.

    Because I am tall, I am the centre.Traupman 43

See also team, position.

SourcesLewis & Short: centralis

John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, pp. 43, 46, 47, 48.
